text:
sam: FYI canary/runtime-change caused an odd SSE behavior: out-of-order keepalive chunks ended up creating a second session id for same resume token, doubling quota charges and triggering a route spike alert in console.

evelyn: ugh. do we have logs?

sam: condensed trace:

```
[09:41:02] proxy-edge: sse open tenant=theta session=aa11 route=blue
[09:41:10] proxy-edge: keepalive chunk seq=14 arrived
[09:41:11] proxy-edge: keepalive chunk seq=13 arrived (late)
[09:41:11] proxy-edge: seq-gap detected -> recovery spawned session=bb22 route=green
[09:41:11] billing: charge tenant=theta session=bb22 cost=3
[09:41:12] proxy-edge: original session aa11 resumed/closed
[09:41:12] billing: charge tenant=theta session=aa11 cost=3
```

rob: the fast-path added to accept late chunks seems to treat them as new streams when reorder threshold crossed. that shouldn't spawn a new session.

billing-bot: ledger shows two quick charges flagged as potential-duplicate for tenant=theta. recon job queued.

console-dev: console smoothing (1m window) grouped by route and hid session lineage, so ops saw only a Route-Green spike. we can add a quick UI hint to fetch recent session ids when a route spike occurs.

evelyn: short-term fixes: increase reassembly window, disable fast-path in canary, add metric proxy.chunk.reorder.fastpath.

rob: medium-term: small cross-cluster cache to map resume-token -> last-billed-session TTL=15s to avoid double billing on splits, and standardize session-lineage fields propagated through telemetry.

sre-oncall: suggest temporarily raising alert thresholds for the canary cohort to avoid noisy pages while we validate.

console-dev: will add toggle to show session lineage and mark resume-token/session fields as high-priority for sampling during rollouts.

sam: action items:
- evelyn: rollback fast-path and make reassembly window configurable (aim 2h)
- rob: billing dedupe rule on resume-token 15s TTL (wip)
- console-dev: quick UI hint + sampling change (aim 4h)
- sre-oncall: bump canary alert thresholds (temporary)

sam: pin incident until ledger reconcile completes. tagging @billing-bot for updates.
